stable.notes: Search results read like conversations again. Snippets are cut by the server as a raw window out of the archive file, so a hit near the top of a chat dragged sessionId, exchanges and role into the result; they are now cleaned to the sentence a person actually said. A search also opens on its matches instead of making you flip a switch, and stays unfiltered when nothing matched so a day is never mysteriously empty. Finally, search tolerates a typo: Thulle finds Thule, while short words still match exactly, because at three letters almost every word is one edit from another. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
